targets.rawSql:
SELECT src_name, src_addr, bytes AS current_bytes, formatReadableSize(bytes) AS current_readable, baseline_buckets, formatReadableSize(p95_bytes) AS p95_readable, ratio_to_p95, flows
FROM flow_poc.v_current_hour_device_vs_baseline
ORDER BY ifNull(ratio_to_p95,0) DESC, current_bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port, recent_bytes AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(recent_bytes) AS readable_bytes, recent_flows
FROM flow_poc.v_recent_new_external_destinations
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT src_name, src_addr, proto, dst_port, recent_bytes AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(recent_bytes) AS readable_bytes, recent_flows
FROM flow_poc.v_recent_new_dst_ports
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
  AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR match(src_addr, '^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.'))
  AND NOT (startsWith(dst_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'192.168.') OR match(dst_addr, '^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.'))
GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
  AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR match(src_addr, '^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.'))
  AND NOT (startsWith(dst_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'192.168.') OR match(dst_addr, '^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.'))
  AND dst_port NOT IN (80,443,53,123,22)
GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, proto, dst_port
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, src_port, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (src_port=22 OR dst_port=22)
GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, proto, src_port, dst_port
ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT src_name, src_addr, count() AS flows, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, sum(packets) AS packets
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
  AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR match(src_addr, '^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.'))
GROUP BY src_name, src_addr
ORDER BY flows DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT src_name, src_addr, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows
FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND proto='UDP' AND (dst_port=443 OR src_port=443)
  AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR match(src_addr, '^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.'))
GROUP BY src_name, src_addr ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25
